636c7922:  ;
 ;This routine generates a report of Patient Data from the Patient Data File
 ;(#393) for a specified Division (Institution), Patient, Physician,
 ;Service and/or Date. It facilitates the extraction of information.
 ;Selection criteria for the report are provided by parameters passed
 ;from entry points in other routines.
c75583a6: ;Process the parameters to generate the report.
37279c90: ;If processing completed, retrieve any additional data needed for output.
d369f82d: ;Exit point.
6df5e732: ;Store the input Division in a temporary variable.
d371b161: ;If Division file entry exists, retrieve and display Division name.
0c4b0f31: ;None - not used.
6dfbbb5f: ;Format the Date and output.
e7f8cbc4: ;Process Patient records.
b5bc8a8d: ;None - not used.
f875333d: ;Process Patient data records.
124d8136: ;None - not used.
f1034ebb: ;If not first Physician, output header.
3b5c42c9: ;Process Physician records.
c17d5ba7: ;None - not used.
7f8b8cf8: ;Process Physician data records.
b56b717c: ;None - not used.
b8218210: ;Process Date records.
b9c0e9fc: ;None - not used.
b98ff8be: ;Process Date data records.
ebfbd5ab: ;Routine to print reports on a date or service basis.
3e1536fc: ;If this is the first time thru for this division, print the header.
a7655fee: ;For each service & specialty for this division, print specialty detail.
0ba2dcfb: ;Loop through patients for this service & specialty.
d6617db5: ;Loop through encounters for this patient.
11a131f6: ;Loop through health factors for this encounter.
33a4e404: ;Print health factor detail.
7a193eb9: ;Done with specialty.
713ebdf3: ;Get provider name from health factor record.
7f8b1ef5: ;If not physician report, print date before patient.
dae82564: ;If date report, print date.
51eb941d: ;If not date report, advance to new line.
bba8e23d: ;Print patient name.
21784192: ;Print patient ID.
b6ced931: ;If not date report, print date of health factor.
49c3e337: ;Print disability type associated with health factor.
9c12b016: ;Print clinic name associated with health factor.
7e9bee6f: ;Print latest rating information for this patient.
9fdea31a: ;If physician report, skip rest of detail line.
19d96c17: ;Print physician header information.
75ab1882: Print attending physician for category types other than 'PHY'.
8ce9250a: Print the three-character application package code.
86a83609: Print the outpatient credit type for division type 2.
dae8a684: Print the length of stay.
60e3f8fe: End of routine DGJOPRT2.
d6ea2b92: Call routine DGJOPRT3 to print header.
8de076eb: If output device is not a terminal and category is 'PAT' or 'DAT', go to RET1.
a14f80e5: If output device is not a terminal, quit.
00037f32: Print empty lines to reach 3 lines from the bottom of the page.
c995fca9: Print division header.
acc1a619: Read user input for continue or quit. Set flag if user enters '^' or times out.
69ee2bb5: If output is near the bottom of the page and category is 'PAT' or 'DAT', ask to continue, print header if continuing.
247bc31b: If output is near the bottom of the page, ask to continue if terminal, print header if continuing.
950b3234: End of subroutine RELP.
46d6f0f0: Print division header.
c3bd9377: Print physician header.
9b900e45: Print service header.
b5e1125d: Print specialty header.

65513825: Call routine DGJOPRT3 to print service related data.
